source_refs.note: iii) Mesosphere: a main subheading of 14.1 Layers of the atmosphere, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 306-306.

blocks.text: It extends to a height of about 50 – 85 km from the ground. Here, the temperature decreases with altitude from -2 °C to -93 °C. The coldest region of the atmosphere is located in this layer.
